synth.notes:
Frame-native mirror-axis rule: parse 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks by ring colour + centre (axis 10, targets 11, reflections 4, pieces 5; centre 0 = selected).
Step: A1-A4 move the selected axis (rows only, may not enter piece rows) or piece (stays in board, off the axis row and other pieces); A5 cycles axis -> pieces largest first -> axis.
Render: bg 9 < axis band (dots 0 if selected) < solid targets < reflections (row 2a-r, clipped, not drawn under pieces; centre 11 over target) < pieces (centre 11 over target, 0 if selected, else 9).
HUD: column 63's first 11 turns 12 only when the action changes the model (A3 with the axis selected = no tick). Passes 29/29 with and without hidden state.
Not confirmed: A5 order from one piece to the next, piece-onto-axis blocking (never tried), and A6/A7 (treated as no-ops).
